descriptions.rgb: A wooded slope rises in front of the camera wearer toward a light-colored house roughly 10–15 m away, with trees scattered about 2–8 m ahead and a low rock border near the house. The person is within arm’s reach of the rocks and ground, while only the sloping ground and nearby vegetation are within the camera wearer’s arm’s reach. Tree trunks partly occlude the house, whose upper and side portions extend beyond the top and lateral frame edges, and the person is partly out of view at the right edge when first visible. Across the five frames, the view turns to the right, making the house, rock border, and person shift from the right toward the left; the person then passes out of view to the left, with no clear substantial approach or retreat.
